===Starting out===
{{Checklist|
*Speak to [[King Roald]]. {{Chat option|1 I'm looking for a quest!|1 Yes.|3 I'll get going.}}
*Bring a ranged or melee weapon for the next part, to kill the [[Temple Guardian]].
**Magic attacks and the [[Dwarf Multicannon]] will not work.
*Head to the temple east of [[Varrock]] by the river.
*Click on the large door. {{Chat option|1 Roald sent me to check on Drezel.|1 Sure. I'm a helpful person!}}
*Climb down the trapdoor just to the north. {{Chat option|1 Yes.}}
*Kill the [[Temple Guardian]]. Players may safespot it by getting it stuck in the middle section of the room against the east wall and standing on the east wall one section north.
}}
